FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say 'Hi, Kamau!' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Salut, Kamau !
   B. Oui, ça va.
   C. Comment tu t'appelles ?
   D. Bonsoir, Madame !

2. The zh sound in French is most like the sound in which English word? (1 mark)
   A. measure
   B. chair
   C. ship
   D. jump

3. How do you say 'My father is called David.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est ma sœur.
   B. J'ai un frère et une sœur.
   C. C'est le bébé.
   D. Mon père s'appelle David.

4. What does 'le grand-père' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the grandmother
   B. the father
   C. the child
   D. the grandfather

5. What does 'entre' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. on
   B. between
   C. behind
   D. in

6. What does 'une fête' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. a present
   B. a party
   C. a song
   D. a birthday

7. What does 'un anniversaire' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. a present
   B. a cake
   C. a song
   D. a birthday

8. Which month is 'avril'? (1 mark)
   A. January
   B. August
   C. April
   D. May

9. What does 'la santé' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. health
   B. milk
   C. the mango
   D. vegetables

10. What does 'la banane' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. rice
   B. vegetables
   C. the cake
   D. the banana

11. How do you say 'They are oranges.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Je mange une mangue.
   B. J'aime la mangue.
   C. C'est une banane.
   D. Ce sont des oranges.

12. How do you say 'I have two eyes.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai une bouche.
   B. J'ai deux pieds.
   C. J'ai deux mains.
   D. J'ai deux yeux.

13. How do you say 'I have a mouth.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai une bouche.
   B. Elle a les cheveux longs.
   C. J'ai deux pieds.
   D. Il a les cheveux courts.

14. What does 'l'oreille' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the ear
   B. the back
   C. the stomach
   D. the neck

15. How do you say 'The TV is on the table.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?
   B. La télé est sur la table.
   C. Le lit est dans la chambre.
   D. La porte est à côté de la fenêtre.

16. Which letters say wa in bonsoir? (1 mark)
   A. ou
   B. au
   C. on
   D. oi

17. What does 'Au revoir, Monsieur.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Yes, I am fine.
   B. Hi, Kamau!
   C. Pleased to meet you!
   D. Goodbye, Sir.

18. Which little word goes with 'famille' (the family)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. les
   C. la
   D. l'

19. What does 'Voici ma grand-mère.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. My sister is called Njeri.
   B. Here is my grandfather.
   C. My mother is called Grace.
   D. Here is my grandmother.

20. What does 'Merci beaucoup !' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Thank you very much!
   B. I am ten years old.
   C. There is a cake and there are balloons.
   D. Happy birthday!

21. Fill in: Je ______ un jus. (I drink) (1 mark)
   A. suis
   B. bois
   C. aime
   D. mange

22. Which little word goes with 'poisson' (the fish)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. l'
   C. les
   D. le

23. What does 'Je n'aime pas le poisson.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is a banana.
   B. I drink a juice.
   C. I do not like fish.
   D. It is good for your health.

24. Which little word goes with 'vent' (the wind)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. les
   C. le
   D. la

25. Which little word goes with 'clé' (the key)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. l'
   C. les
   D. la

26. How do you say 'How do you spell it?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Je m'appelle Amina.
   B. Ça va ?
   C. Et toi ?
   D. Ça s'écrit comment ?

27. Fill in: ______ grand-mère s'appelle Grace. (1 mark)
   A. Mon
   B. Un
   C. Ma
   D. Le

28. How do you say 'the ball' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la chambre
   B. le ballon
   C. le canapé
   D. la chaise

29. How do you say 'the bag' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la cuisine
   B. la douche
   C. la salle de bain
   D. le sac

30. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'sofa'? (1 mark)
   A. canapè
   B. canapé
   C. canape
   D. caapé

31. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'school'? (1 mark)
   A. ecole
   B. école
   C. ècole
   D. écoe

32. Which day ends in che? (1 mark)
   A. lundi
   B. jeudi
   C. dimanche
   D. samedi

33. How do you write the number 8 in French? (1 mark)
   A. dix-neuf
   B. vingt-cinq
   C. douze
   D. huit

34. How do you write the number 25 in French? (1 mark)
   A. trente et un
   B. vingt
   C. vingt-cinq
   D. dix-neuf

35. How do you say the month 'February' in French? (1 mark)
   A. mars
   B. septembre
   C. février
   D. novembre

36. How do you say 'sweets' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la banane
   B. les bonbons
   C. les haricots
   D. le thé

37. How do you say 'long' in French? (1 mark)
   A. court
   B. long
   C. grand
   D. noir

38. How do you say 'the hair' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le nez
   B. les cheveux
   C. l'oreille
   D. l'épaule

39. How do you say 'the sun' in French? (1 mark)
   A. une inondation
   B. le soleil
   C. la pluie
   D. le nuage

40. How do you say 'the key' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la clé
   B. le magasin
   C. le jardin
   D. le tapis

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Translate into French: 'When is your birthday?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

42. Write the months from juillet to décembre in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Translate into English: 'Mon anniversaire, c'est le 12 mai.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Write a weather dialogue of three lines in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into English: 'Ce sont des mangues.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

46. Translate into English: 'Elle a les cheveux noirs.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

47. Write the French words for: the baby, the child, the mother (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into English: 'J'ai deux yeux.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

49. Translate into French: 'I eat a mango.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

50. Translate into French: 'Excuse me, where is the school?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

51. Translate into French: 'On Saturday, I help my mother.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

52. Explain the difference between mon and ma. Give one example of each. (4 marks) (4 marks)

53. Translate into English: 'C'est le bébé.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

54. Write the French words for: hi, bye, no, Sir, Mr (3 marks) (3 marks)

55. Translate into English: 'C'est un lit.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

56. Write three sentences in French with J'ai and a number about your body. (3 marks) (3 marks)

57. Translate into French: 'It is a cake.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

58. Describe a friend in three sentences in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

59. Translate into French: 'Yes, I am fine.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

60. Translate into French: 'Tomorrow it is Thursday.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

61. Translate into English: 'Allez tout droit.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

62. Translate into English: 'Ma mère s'appelle Grace.' (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Salut, Kamau !
   Hi, Kamau! in French is Salut, Kamau !

2. A — measure
   The s in measure is the same soft zh sound as the French j.

3. D — Mon père s'appelle David.
   My father is called David. in French is Mon père s'appelle David.

4. D — the grandfather
   le grand-père means the grandfather.

5. B — between
   entre means between.

6. B — a party
   une fête means a party.

7. D — a birthday
   un anniversaire means a birthday.

8. C — April
   avril means April.

9. A — health
   la santé means health.

10. D — the banana
   la banane means the banana.

11. D — Ce sont des oranges.
   They are oranges. in French is Ce sont des oranges.

12. D — J'ai deux yeux.
   I have two eyes. in French is J'ai deux yeux.

13. A — J'ai une bouche.
   I have a mouth. in French is J'ai une bouche.

14. A — the ear
   l'oreille means the ear.

15. B — La télé est sur la table.
   The TV is on the table. in French is La télé est sur la table.

16. D — oi
   In French, oi says wa.

17. D — Goodbye, Sir.
   Au revoir, Monsieur. means Goodbye, Sir.

18. C — la
   famille is feminine, so we say la famille.

19. D — Here is my grandmother.
   Voici ma grand-mère. means Here is my grandmother.

20. A — Thank you very much!
   Merci beaucoup ! means Thank you very much!

21. B — bois
   Je bois means I drink.

22. D — le
   poisson is masculine, so we say le poisson.

23. C — I do not like fish.
   Je n'aime pas le poisson. means I do not like fish.

24. C — le
   vent is masculine, so we say le vent.

25. D — la
   clé is feminine, so we say la clé.

26. D — Ça s'écrit comment ?
   How do you spell it? in French is Ça s'écrit comment ?.

27. C — Ma
   Grand-mère is feminine.

28. B — le ballon
   the ball in French is le ballon.

29. D — le sac
   the bag in French is le sac.

30. B — canapé
   The correct spelling is canapé, with its accents.

31. B — école
   The correct spelling is école, with its accents.

32. C — dimanche
   Dimanche is the only day that ends in che.

33. D — huit
   8 in French is huit.

34. C — vingt-cinq
   25 in French is vingt-cinq.

35. C — février
   February in French is février.

36. B — les bonbons
   sweets in French is les bonbons.

37. B — long
   long in French is long.

38. B — les cheveux
   the hair in French is les cheveux.

39. B — le soleil
   the sun in French is le soleil.

40. A — la clé
   the key in French is la clé.
